    function setupCanvas(canvas){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),d=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=Math.round(r.width*d);canvas.height=Math.round(r.height*d);return canvas.getContext('2d')}
    function circle(ctx,x,y,r,fill){ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
    function lineGuide(ctx,w,h,start,end){ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';ctx.lineWidth=10*(w/900);ctx.setLineDash([17*(w/900),15*(w/900)]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(start[0]*w,start[1]*h);ctx.lineTo(end[0]*w,end[1]*h);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);circle(ctx,start[0]*w,start[1]*h,22*(w/900),'#6ef19b');circle(ctx,end[0]*w,end[1]*h,22*(w/900),'#ffdc28')}
    function startConnect(){const task=CONNECT_TASKS[fromBag('connect',CONNECT_TASKS.map((_,i)=>i))];state.connect={task,done:false};$('#connect-progress').textContent='第一關・連一連';$('#connect-prompt').textContent=`請把「${ASSETS[task.left].label}」連到右邊正確的圖片。`;$('#connect-left-image').src=ASSETS[task.left].src;$('#connect-left-image').alt=ASSETS[task.left].label;$('#connect-left-label').textContent=ASSETS[task.left].label;$('#connect-right-image').src=ASSETS[task.right].src;$('#connect-right-image').alt=ASSETS[task.right].label;$('#connect-right-label').textContent=ASSETS[task.right].label;$('#connect-status').textContent='';drawConnectBoard();say($('#connect-prompt').textContent)}
    function drawConnectBoard(){const canvas=$('#connect-canvas'),ctx=setupCanvas(canvas),w=canvas.width,h=canvas.height,start=[.20,.50],end=[.80,.50];ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);lineGuide(ctx,w,h,start,end);state.connect.ctx=ctx;state.connect.canvas=canvas;state.connect.start=start;state.connect.end=end;state.connect.drawing=false;state.connect.moves=0;const draw=e=>{if(!state.connect.drawing||state.connect.done)return;const p=canvasPoint(e,canvas);ctx.setLineDash([]);ctx.strokeStyle='#32d8ff';ctx.lineWidth=18*(w/900);ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.stroke();state.connect.last=p;state.connect.moves++};canvas.onpointerdown=e=>{const p=canvasPoint(e,canvas),sx=start[0]*w,sy=start[1]*h;if(Math.hypot(p.x-sx,p.y-sy)>75*(w/900)){say('請由綠色圓點開始。');return}canvas.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);state.connect.drawing=true;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y);state.connect.last=p};canvas.onpointermove=draw;canvas.onpointerup=()=>{if(!state.connect.drawing)return;state.connect.drawing=false;const p=state.connect.last||{x:0,y:0},ex=end[0]*w,ey=end[1]*h;if(state.connect.moves>8&&Math.hypot(p.x-ex,p.y-ey)<90*(w/900)){state.connect.done=true;feedback({title:'做得好！',text:`「${ASSETS[state.connect.task.left].label}」和「${ASSETS[state.connect.task.right].label}」配對正確。`,image:state.connect.task.right,next:'下一題',action:startConnect})}else{say('差一點，請由綠色圓點重新連線。')}};canvas.onpointercancel=()=>state.connect.drawing=false}
    function setFillEraser(on){state.fill.erasing=on;const b=$('#fill-eraser');b.textContent=`⌫ 橡皮擦：${on?'開':'關'}`;b.classList.toggle('eraser-on',on)}
    function drawFillShape(){const canvas=$('#fill-canvas'),ctx=setupCanvas(canvas),w=canvas.width;ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);state.fill.canvas=canvas;state.fill.ctx=ctx;state.fill.drawing=false;state.fill.moves=0;const paint=e=>{if(!state.fill.drawing)return;const p=canvasPoint(e,canvas);ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation=state.fill.erasing?'destination-out':'source-over';ctx.fillStyle=state.fill.task.colour;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,34*(w/900),0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();state.fill.moves++};canvas.onpointerdown=e=>{canvas.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);state.fill.drawing=true;paint(e)};canvas.onpointermove=paint;canvas.onpointerup=()=>state.fill.drawing=false;canvas.onpointercancel=()=>state.fill.drawing=false}
    function startFill(index=0){const task=FILL_TASKS[index];state.fill={task,index,erasing:false,moves:0};$('#fill-progress').textContent=`初組・第 ${index+1} 題／共 ${FILL_TASKS.length} 題`;$('#fill-prompt').textContent=`請在「${task.name}」的框線內填上${task.colourName}。`;$('#fill-template').src=task.template;$('#fill-template').alt=`${task.name}框線`;$('#fill-colour').className=`colour-dot ${task.key==='hat'?'yellow':'red'}`;$('#fill-colour-name').textContent=task.colourName;setFillEraser(false);requestAnimationFrame(drawFillShape);say(task.voice)}
    function setStrokeEraser(on){state.stroke.erasing=on;const b=$('#stroke-eraser');b.textContent=`⌫ 橡皮擦：${on?'開':'關'}`;b.classList.toggle('eraser-on',on)}
    function strokeVoice(){const t=state.stroke.task;say(`${t.char}。${t.example}。請用黑色補上缺失筆畫。`)}
    function drawStrokeBoard(){const canvas=$('#stroke-canvas'),ctx=setupCanvas(canvas),w=canvas.width;ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);state.stroke.canvas=canvas;state.stroke.ctx=ctx;state.stroke.drawing=false;state.stroke.moves=0;const draw=e=>{if(!state.stroke.drawing)return;const p=canvasPoint(e,canvas);ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation=state.stroke.erasing?'destination-out':'source-over';ctx.strokeStyle='#000000';ctx.lineWidth=22*(w/900);ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();state.stroke.moves++};canvas.onpointerdown=e=>{canvas.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);state.stroke.drawing=true;const p=canvasPoint(e,canvas);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y);draw(e)};canvas.onpointermove=draw;canvas.onpointerup=()=>state.stroke.drawing=false;canvas.onpointercancel=()=>state.stroke.drawing=false}
    function startStroke(index=0){const task=STROKE_TASKS[index];state.stroke={task,index,erasing:false,moves:0};$('#stroke-progress').textContent=`高組・第 ${index+1} 級／共 ${STROKE_TASKS.length} 級`;$('#stroke-prompt').textContent=`請先聽「${task.char}」字讀音，再用黑色補上缺失筆畫。`;$('#stroke-template').src=task.guide;$('#stroke-template').alt=`${task.char}字紅色缺失筆畫提示`;$('#stroke-status').textContent='';setStrokeEraser(false);requestAnimationFrame(drawStrokeBoard);strokeVoice()}
    $('#home-btn').addEventListener('click',()=>show('home'));$('#start-btn').addEventListener('click',()=>show('tasks'));$$('[data-home]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>show('home')));$$('[data-open]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>nextActivity(b.dataset.open)));$$('[data-back]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>show(b.dataset.back)));$('#feedback-next').addEventListener('click',closeFeedback);
    $('#story-full').addEventListener('click',()=>say(PPT_STORY));$('#picture-replay').addEventListener('click',()=>say(`請找出${ASSETS[state.picture.key].label}`));$('#listen-replay').addEventListener('click',()=>say(`請找出${ASSETS[state.listenword.key].label}`));$('#quiz-replay').addEventListener('click',()=>say(state.quiz.q.q));$('#connect-clear').addEventListener('click',drawConnectBoard);$('#fill-eraser').addEventListener('click',()=>setFillEraser(!state.fill.erasing));$('#fill-clear').addEventListener('click',()=>{setFillEraser(false);drawFillShape()});$('#fill-done').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(state.fill.moves<8){say('請先在框線內塗畫。');return}const next=state.fill.index+1;feedback({title:'做得好！',text:`你努力為「${state.fill.task.name}」填上${state.fill.task.colourName}。`,image:state.fill.task.key,next:next<FILL_TASKS.length?'下一題':'完成初組書寫',action:()=>next<FILL_TASKS.length?startFill(next):show('writemenu')})});$('#stroke-audio').addEventListener('click',strokeVoice);$('#stroke-eraser').addEventListener('click',()=>setStrokeEraser(!state.stroke.erasing));$('#stroke-clear').addEventListener('click',()=>{setStrokeEraser(false);drawStrokeBoard()});$('#stroke-done').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(state.stroke.moves<4){say('請先用紅色補上筆畫。');return}const next=state.stroke.index+1;feedback({title:'做得好！',text:`你完成了「${state.stroke.task.char}」字的黑色補筆畫。`,next:next<STROKE_TASKS.length?'下一個字':'完成高組書寫',action:()=>next<STROKE_TASKS.length?startStroke(next):show('writemenu')})});window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(state.screen==='connectwrite')drawConnectBoard();if(state.screen==='fillwrite')drawFillShape();if(state.screen==='strokewrite')drawStrokeBoard()});
  </script>
</body>
